save_roast_quote.name: save_roast_quote
save_roast_quote.description: Save the agent's best roast one-liner for the report card (from the roast segment only). Call this after Phase 4. After it returns, ask the user a follow-up question — don't leave the conversation hanging.

parameters.description: The single best roast one-liner from the monologue just delivered — the line most likely to be screenshotted. Verbatim from Phase 3, as a short string. No session_id.

research_internship.name: research_internship
research_internship.description: Triggers internship research on the USER'S BACKEND (browser → API → Firecrawl + AI). You do not browse the web yourself. When this tool returns JSON with research_complete true, research is ALREADY DONE — start the roast immediately; never ask the user to confirm data loaded. The JSON includes company_verdicts (per-company verdict, reason, skill_gaps, one_fix), overall_readiness_score, top_skill_gaps, tips, and honest_take. Use ALL of these in the roast.

parameters.description: The student's field of study or major as they stated it (e.g. Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Finance). Use their exact wording. Never invent a major they did not describe.
The college or university name they said they attend. Use their wording. Do not make up a specific school name.
Comma-separated list of companies the student said they are targeting for internships (e.g. Google, Stripe, a fintech startup). Use their exact words. At least one required.
Their CGPA or GPA as a decimal number (e.g. 8.2 or 3.7). If not stated, empty string. Do not fabricate.
Their current year of study as a digit (1, 2, 3, or 4). Infer from what they said: 'second year' → 2, 'junior' → 3. If unknown, empty string.
Comma-separated list of technical skills they mentioned (e.g. Python, React, SQL, Machine Learning). Only include what they actually said. Empty string if none mentioned.
Comma-separated list of relevant courses or certifications they mentioned. Empty string if none.
Any internship, project, or work experience they described, as a short summary. Empty string if none.
Comma-separated list of programming or spoken languages they mentioned knowing. Empty string if none.
Where they study or want to intern if they said it (e.g. India, UK, US, Singapore). Empty string if unknown.
